string.text: Sorry, I don't have time for this right now.
Suit yourself. The offer stands, you know where to find me.
No problem. The job isn't going anywhere.
I understand. But time is against us.
Give me a moment. I'll come back for the details.
Fine, but don't keep me waiting. Time is money.
Take your time. I'll be here.
Don't take too long.
Don't take long, kid.
Don't wait too long, kid.
Don't take too long. This can't wait.
Eh, I was going to give you a rifle that's been gathering dust in my stash for ages. But I see you're already carrying something much better than that junk. Here, take the money instead.
Eh, I had a suit put aside for you, it's been lying in my storeroom for ages. But looking at what you're wearing, you'd laugh at it. Here, take the money instead.
Eh, I was going to give you an old backpack from my storeroom, but yours is better than anything I've got lying around. Here, take the money instead.
I set aside a rifle from our armory for you, but next to what you're carrying it's a toy. Take the money instead, you'll find a better use for it.
Our techs had a suit ready for you, but yours is better than anything we could spare. Take the money instead, you'll find a better use for it.
I had a backpack put aside for you, but yours is better than ours. Take the money instead, you'll find a better use for it.
I meant to give you a rifle from our stores. But you're already better armed than half my men. Take the money - buy whatever you need.
I was going to give you one of our suits. But what you're wearing is better than anything in our stores, it would be an insult. Take the money instead.
I meant to give you one of our backpacks, but yours is better. Take the money - buy whatever you need.
I had a rifle stashed away for you, kid. Kept it oiled and everything. But looks like you've outgrown it - you're better armed than I am. Take the money, then.
I had a suit stashed away for you, kid. But looks like you've outgrown it - yours is better than mine. Take the money, then.
I had a backpack stashed away for you, kid, but yours is better than mine. Take the money, then.
Fair enough. Money always comes in handy.

Eh, the rifle I'd put aside for you would be a step down from what you're carrying. So here's something better instead. It's been through a lot, I won't lie - but the barrel is like new, and that's the part you can't fix with a file and some grease. The rest you'll patch up yourself.
The rifle I had for you would be a step down for you. Here's a better one from a fallen fighter's stash. It's seen hard use, but the barrel is perfect - our techs checked. The rest you can fix.
What I had in our stores is worse than what you carry. Take this one instead - it went through hell with us, but the barrel is like new. Get the rest fixed and it will serve you well.
The rifle I kept for you would be a step down, kid. So take this one. Beaten up, I know, but the barrel is like new - and that's what counts. The rest you can fix.
A good barrel is what counts. I'll fix the rest myself.
I need to think about it.
The Noise: someone has the next step of the story for you. Talk to them.
The Noise: the Kamerton for Clear Sky. Give it to Cold.
The Noise: the Kamerton for sale. Give it to Sidorovich.
The Noise: destroy the Kamerton. Talk to Wolf.
The PDA hisses: the Noise again - quieter than before, from somewhere to the north. A moment later Cold's frequency lights up.
The Noise again - faint, from somewhere to the north. Right after it, Sidorovich's frequency.
The Noise again - faint and far off, from somewhere to the north. Then Wolf's voice on the radio.
Metal Cylinder
A heavy metal cylinder with worn-off military markings. It was in the package carried by Sidorovich's courier. Hold it to your ear and you can hear a faint, pulsing noise.
Viktor's PDA
The PDA of a Clear Sky scout. Recordings of the noise and a photo of a military helicopter over the swamp. Spore is waiting for it.
Kostya's PDA
The PDA of the Clear Sky strike team leader. The last entry mentions cargo from Agroprom called the Kamerton.
Flight Recorder
A scorched flight recorder from the military helicopter that went down in the Great Swamps. Encrypted with a military code.
Sidorovich's Package
A carefully wrapped and sealed package. Sid says it's ordinary goods. Better not to open it.
Convoy Officer's PDA
The PDA of the army officer from the convoy in Agroprom. The last entry breaks off mid-word.
Kamerton
A military prototype in a heavy crate. The casing is warm to the touch, and a barely audible noise comes from inside. People die because of it.
The Noise: A Job Offer
Sidorovich, the trader in the Cordon village bunker, called me on the radio. He's heard I'm new in the Zone and says he's looking for workers. I should go and see him.
Talk to Sidorovich.
You called me on the radio. Something about work?
Right, the rookie. Let me take a look at you... Thin, hungry, and with gear that wouldn't scare a blind dog. Good. The hungry ones work hard.
What kind of work?
Honest work, for now. Here's how it goes, rookie: I give you jobs, you do them, I pay. Do them well, and the jobs get better, and so does the pay. We'll start with something simple.
Something simple? Go on.
Boars. A small herd has been coming right up to the village these past few days. Hunt them down, cut off two legs with your knife and bring them to me. Boar meat sells, and I'll pay you for it.
I'm going hunting.
I've marked where they were seen. Aim for the head and don't get trampled. Once they're down, walk up to the carcass and use your knife.
The boars are dead. Here are the legs.
Fresh, good. Here's your money. But hunting is only half of it. Nobody will feed you in the Zone, and canned food runs out faster than you think. You'd better learn to cook.
The Noise: The Hunt
Sidorovich wants me to hunt the boars that have been coming up to the village, cut off two legs with my knife and bring them to him. The herd is marked on my PDA.
The boars are dead and I have two legs. Return to Sidorovich.
Cook? You want me to make you dinner?

Not me - Wolf. He keeps order in the village, and he's been sitting by the fire since morning without a bite. Here's a cooker, some charcoal and a cut of boar meat. Cook it at the campfire and take it to him. Wolf is a good man to know around here, and it won't hurt you to be on his good side.
I'll cook the meat and take it to Wolf.
Here's everything you need. Use the cooker at the campfire and pick the boar meat. Keep the cooker, you'll need it. And come back to me afterwards - I'll have a real job for you.
Wolf, Sid sent you some food. Cooked it myself.
Fresh boar, look at that. Thanks, kid. So the old miser already has you on his payroll?
Something like that. He says he'll have a real job for me.

Then go and see him, and keep your eyes open. One of his couriers was supposed to come through here yesterday and never showed up. If Sid starts talking about bandits, take it seriously. Here, a little something for the meal.
The Noise: By the Campfire
Sidorovich gave me a cooker, charcoal and boar meat. I need to cook it at the campfire and take it to Wolf.
The meat is cooked. Take it to Wolf.
Wolf is fed and happy. You mentioned a real job?

I did. Grisha, my courier from the Swamps, was due here yesterday with a package. He never arrived. This morning a bandit was seen near the village carrying a bag that isn't his. Find him, take him out and search the body. Whatever he took from Grisha is mine - bring it back. And take this double-barrel, call it an advance. You won't do this job with your bare hands.

I did. Grisha, my courier from the Swamps, was due here yesterday with a package. He never arrived. This morning a bandit was seen near the village carrying a bag that isn't his. Find him, take him out and search the body. Whatever he took from Grisha is mine - bring it back. I hope you've got a gun on you - you won't do this job with your bare hands.
I'll find him.
He's marked on your PDA. And don't get yourself shot - dead men don't collect payment.
The bandit's dead. He had this on him - a metal cylinder.
That's all? So the rest of the package is gone... Let me see. Military make, never seen anything like it.
There's something else. When I picked it up, my PDA started hissing. A strange, pulsing noise, and then it just stopped.

...A noise. I've been catching something like that on my radio for weeks, always right before an emission. I don't like this, rookie. Hold on to the cylinder for now, too many eyes around my counter. And here - a jacket and a gas mask. You've earned them, and you'll need them for what comes next.
The Noise: The Missing Courier
Sidorovich's courier Grisha never arrived. A bandit seen near the village may have robbed him. I need to kill the bandit and search the body. The target is marked on my PDA.
The bandit is dead and I have a metal cylinder from the courier's package. When I picked it up, my PDA caught a strange noise. Return to Sidorovich.
What comes next?

The anomaly field near the village. A Jellyfish has formed there - an artifact, worth good money. But I want more than money this time: if that noise has anything to do with anomalies, that's where you'll hear it. Bring me the Jellyfish and tell me what you heard. You'll get a proper backpack and some medicine.

The anomaly field near the village. A Jellyfish has formed there - an artifact, worth good money. But I want more than money this time: if that noise has anything to do with anomalies, that's where you'll hear it. Bring me the Jellyfish and tell me what you heard. I'll pay you well.

The anomaly field near the village. A Jellyfish has formed there - an artifact, worth good money. But I want more than money this time: if that noise has anything to do with anomalies, that's where you'll hear it. Bring me the Jellyfish and tell me what you heard. I'll pay you well, and throw in some medicine.
I'll bring you the Jellyfish.
The spot is marked on your PDA. Take out your detector and throw bolts ahead of you. And don't keep the Jellyfish in your backpack too long, it's a bit radioactive.
I've got the Jellyfish. And Sid, the noise was there again. Louder this time, as if it were right next to me.
Twice in Cordon in one week... This is bigger than a lost package. Here's the medicine, and something for your trouble. And listen - I think I know who might have answers.
Twice in Cordon in one week... This is bigger than a lost package. Here's your money. And listen - I think I know who might have answers.
The Noise: Jellyfish

A Jellyfish has formed in the anomaly field near the village. Sid wants it, and he wants to know whether the noise can be heard there. I need to find it with my detector. Better throw bolts ahead of me.
I have the Jellyfish. The noise was there again, louder. Return to Sidorovich.
Who might have answers?

Grisha was coming from Spore, the Clear Sky trader in the Great Swamps. Clear Sky have been listening to the Swamps for years - if anyone knows what this noise is, it's them. Take Spore the cylinder, he'll know what it is and who it was meant for. Tell him I sent you. Will you go?

Grisha was coming from Spore - your own trader, in the Swamps. You Clear Sky lot have been listening to the Swamps for years: if anyone knows what this noise is, it's your people. Take Spore the cylinder, he'll know what it is and who it was meant for. Tell him I sent you. Will you go?

Hey, you - the new face in the village. Sidorovich here, the trader in the bunker. Word travels fast: you're fresh in the Zone and short on everything. I'm always looking for people who can work. Drop by my bunker and we'll talk.
The moment you lift the cylinder, the PDA earpiece crackles: a strange, pulsing noise, like a heartbeat under static. A few seconds later, silence.
The detector went crazy. The PDA earpiece carries the same pulsing noise as by the bandit's body, only louder, as if it were right next to you. A few seconds later, silence.
I'm heading to the Swamps.
Spore is marked on your PDA. In the Swamps, stick to dry ground and stay out of the reeds after dark. And don't trust anyone who asks about the cylinder.
Sidorovich sent me. I've got something his courier was carrying.
Grisha... so he didn't make it. Show me.
A metal cylinder. The bandits had it.

Hmm. I don't know what this is, and I don't like it. Leave it with me, I'll have our techs look at it. Look, I don't know you, and in this base we don't discuss things like this with strangers. But I could use a hand. Help us out, and we'll talk as friends.

Hmm. I don't know what this is, and I don't like it. Leave it with me, I'll have our techs look at it. Good thing it ended up with one of ours and not with some stranger. And since you're here - the base could use another pair of hands right now. Help me out.
The Noise: The Road to the Swamps
Sid is sending me with the cylinder to Spore, the trader at the Clear Sky base in the Great Swamps. Grisha the courier was coming from him.
Take the cylinder to Spore at the Clear Sky base.
What do you need a hand with?

Something simple, to start. Renegades - bandits, only dumber and angrier - have crept up to the base again and they shoot anyone who goes out for water. Drive them off. I'll pay, and throw in ammo for whatever you're shooting.
Something simple, to start. Renegades - bandits, only dumber and angrier - have crept up to the base again and they shoot anyone who goes out for water. Drive them off. I'll pay.
I'll take care of the renegades.
They're marked on your PDA. Careful, there's a group of them. The Swamps give plenty of cover - use it.
The renegades won't bother you anymore.
I heard shooting, then silence. Good silence. Here's your money and ammo. As for the cylinder: our techs say it's part of some military device. But right now there's something more urgent.
I heard shooting, then silence. Good silence. Here's your money. As for the cylinder: our techs say it's part of some military device. But right now there's something more urgent.
The Noise: Renegades at the Base
A group of renegades is prowling near the Clear Sky base. Spore wants me to get rid of them. Their position is marked on my PDA.
The renegades are dead. Return to Spore.
Something urgent? What happened?
Viktor, our scout, is missing. He went to find out where the noise in the Swamps comes from and never came back. He had a PDA with recordings. Find him. And if... if he's dead, bring me that PDA.
I'll find him.
I've marked the spot his last signal came from. Search the area.
I found Viktor. He's dead. I have his PDA.

Poor kid... Show me. There's a recording of the noise. And a photo: a military helicopter flying low over the swamp, no markings. So it's the army... Here's your pay. And be careful - after every burst of the Noise the mutants go wild. Something is already prowling around the base.
The Noise: The Missing Scout
Viktor, a Clear Sky scout, went looking for the source of the noise and never came back. I need to find him and bring his PDA to Spore. The location of his last signal is marked on my PDA.
I have Viktor's PDA. Return to Spore.
What's prowling around the base?

A bloodsucker. They used to keep their distance, but ever since the Noise started, this one has been hunting our people right by the fence. I won't lie to you, it's no boar. If you don't have a decent gun and a few medkits, don't go. But kill it and I'll pay you better than for anything so far.
I'll hunt it down.
I've marked where it was last seen. When you hear heavy breathing and see the air shimmer, shoot. Don't wait for it to show itself. And aim for the head.
The bloodsucker is dead.
Really? Ha! The boys will drink to your health for a week. Here, you've earned every coupon. But don't celebrate just yet - we've got trouble with Kostya's squad.
The Noise: Bloodsucker in the Reeds
A bloodsucker, driven from its lair by the Noise, is hunting near the Clear Sky base. Spore wants me to kill it. The place where it was seen is marked on my PDA.
The bloodsucker is dead. Return to Spore.
What happened to Kostya's squad?

Kostya and three men went to check the place where Viktor photographed the helicopter. They were supposed to report in at the meeting point last night. Nothing, the radio is dead. Go to the meeting point and see for yourself. If something happened to them - Kostya always carried his commander's PDA. Take it. And you won't go alone: if whoever got Kostya is still there, one rookie won't stand a chance. I'm sending two of our experienced fighters with you.
I'll go to the meeting point.
The meeting point is marked on your PDA. My two lads are already waiting for you at the base, they'll follow your lead. Go carefully, something isn't right here.

Kostya's PDA, last entry: "We found where the helicopter went down. The army is looking for cargo from Agroprom, they call it the Kamerton. Patrol on our trail..." The entry breaks off. The soldiers' positions are marked in the PDA.
Kostya's squad is dead. The army killed them.
I knew it... I could feel it. What did you find?
Kostya's PDA has an entry about cargo from Agroprom. The army calls it the Kamerton. The soldiers who killed them won't hurt anyone again. Here's the PDA.

The Kamerton... This is a matter for Cold now, not for a trader. Here's your pay, everything I can spare right now. Kostya and the boys... we'll make sure they get buried. And Cold needs to hear all of this from you.
The Noise: The Strike Team

Kostya's Clear Sky squad never reported in. I need to go to the meeting point marked on my PDA and find out what happened. If they're dead, I should take the commander's PDA. Spore sent two experienced Clear Sky fighters with me.

Kostya's squad is dead. According to the last entry in Kostya's PDA, they were killed by an army patrol looking for something called the Kamerton. Kostya managed to mark their position: the soldiers are still nearby. Together with the Clear Sky fighters, I need to eliminate them, then return to Spore with the PDA.
The army patrol is eliminated. Return to Spore with Kostya's PDA.
I'm ready to talk to Cold.

Cold leads Clear Sky. Tell him everything: the cylinder, Viktor, Kostya and the Kamerton. He'll decide what comes next. And don't let him brush you off - you know more about this than anyone in the base.
Go to Cold. Tell him everything: the cylinder, Viktor, Kostya and the Kamerton. He'll decide what comes next. And don't let him brush you off - you know more about this than anyone else in the base.
I'm going to Cold.
He's marked on your PDA. Tell him I sent you.
Spore sent me. It's about the Kamerton.
Spore told me about you. The Kamerton... Do you even know what it is?
Spore told me. Good that it was one of ours who dug this up. The Kamerton... Do you even know what it is?
Only that the army is looking for it and that people die because of it.

A military prototype. It's meant to trigger and measure emissions. The noise you keep hearing is the echo of its tests. If it works, emissions become a weapon. The cylinder you brought is a part of it. And now I need your help.
The Noise: Cold
Spore is sending me to Cold, the leader of Clear Sky. I need to tell him about the cylinder, Viktor, Kostya and the Kamerton.
Talk to Cold.
What do you need me to do?

The helicopter Viktor photographed went down at the edge of the Swamps. You'll know the wreck when you see it. The pilot had a flight recorder on him. If it survived, it holds the route and the orders. Find the pilot by the wreck and take the recorder. Watch out, looters are probably sniffing around already.
I'll find the recorder.
The crash site is marked on your PDA. Come back quickly.
The recorder survived, though the casing is scorched. Voices in the distance - someone is heading for the crash site. Renegades, looters.
I've got the recorder. The renegades wanted it too.

Good work. Take these tools as well, our techs can spare them - out here you will be fixing your own gear. As for the recorder, it's encrypted with a military code - we won't crack it here. Your Sidorovich, though, knows people who can crack anything.

Good work. Here's your pay - spend it wisely, out here you will be fixing your own gear. As for the recorder, it's encrypted with a military code - we won't crack it here. Your Sidorovich, though, knows people who can crack anything.
The Noise: The Wreck
A military helicopter went down at the edge of the Swamps. The pilot's body should have a flight recorder on it. I need to get it.
I have the recorder, but renegade looters are heading for the crash site. I need to deal with them.
I have the recorder. Return to Cold.
You want me to take the recorder to Sid?
Yes. I don't like that miser, but we have no choice. Don't tell him more about the Kamerton than you have to. Sid will sell any information to the highest bidder.
I'll take the recorder to Sid.
Take care of yourself. And come back - this isn't over yet.
Sid, I'm back. I've got the flight recorder from a military helicopter. It needs decrypting.
Well, well, my investment comes back from the Swamps bearing gifts! Let me see... Military cipher. It can be done, I know a guy. But it'll cost you.
How much?
Not money. A favour. Bandits in the Garbage grabbed a package of mine. Get it back, and in the meantime my guy will work on your recorder.
The Noise: The Cipher
The recorder is encrypted with a military code. Cold is sending me with it to Sidorovich, who knows people who can crack ciphers.
Take the recorder to Sidorovich.
What package are we talking about?

Ordinary goods, nothing you need to worry about. A gang in the Garbage intercepted my man, and their boss has the package now. Deal with them and bring it back, and your recorder will sing like a bird.
I'm going to the Garbage.
They're marked on your PDA. The Garbage isn't Cordon, rookie. Over there they shoot first and never bother with questions.
I've got your package.
Not a scratch on it, excellent. Here's your pay. And your recorder is already decrypted - my guy did a fine job. You'll want to hear what's on it.
The Noise: A Favour for Sid
A gang in the Garbage has Sidorovich's package. I need to kill the bandits and get the package back from their boss. Their position is marked on my PDA.
I have Sid's package. Return to Sidorovich.
What's on the recorder?

The route of a convoy out of Agroprom. The Kamerton was being taken to a military lab, but the convoy vanished from the radar two days ago. The army pays a fortune for things like that, Clear Sky probably too, and my buyers from the Big Land would pay more than both of them together. Find the convoy, stalker. Then we'll talk about who gets it.
I'll find the convoy.
Agroprom is crawling with soldiers, mercs and worse. I've marked the convoy's last position from the recorder. Come back alive, I've got money invested in you.

Convoy officer's PDA, last entry: "The noise keeps growing, men are bleeding from their ears, we can't switch it off... Mercenaries near..." The entry breaks off. According to the signals logged in the PDA, a mercenary squad took the crate and is close by.
The Noise: The Dead Convoy
The convoy carrying the Kamerton vanished in Agroprom. Its last known position from the recorder is marked on my PDA. I need to go there and find the convoy. The officer's PDA should be on site.
The convoy soldiers lie there without a scratch, blood trickling from their ears. Mercenaries took the Kamerton. Their position is marked on my PDA. I need to eliminate them and recover the Kamerton.
I have the Kamerton.
The Noise: Kamerton

I have the Kamerton. I can give it to Cold and Clear Sky (Great Swamps), sell it to Sidorovich, or destroy it with Wolf's help (both in Cordon). All three are marked on my PDA map. The choice is mine.
I have the Kamerton. I can give it to Cold, so that Clear Sky can study it (Great Swamps), or destroy it with Wolf's help (Cordon). Both are marked on my PDA map. The choice is mine.
Decide who gets the Kamerton.
Cold, I have the Kamerton.
By the Zone... You really have it. Give it to us, and we'll make sure nobody ever uses it. Kostya, Viktor and the others deserve that much.
Take it. Let Clear Sky deal with the Noise.
Thank you, stalker. Kostya didn't die for nothing. Whatever we can spare is yours - and know that in this base you'll always be one of us.
Thank you. Kostya didn't die for nothing. Whatever we can spare is yours. Clear Sky won't forget what you did for us.
I understand. But don't wait too long, the army is looking for it too.
Sid, I have the Kamerton.
...You actually did it. I knew you were a good investment! My buyers will pay a fortune for this. Your cut: fifteen thousand and a little something extra.
...You actually did it. I knew you were a good investment! My buyers will pay a fortune for this. Your cut: fifteen thousand.
Deal. Take it.
Ha! Here's your money, and something from my storeroom. Clear Sky will be furious, but business is business. And don't tell anyone where the money came from.
Ha! Here's your money. Clear Sky will be furious, but business is business. And don't tell anyone where the money came from.
You're thinking too long, stalker. The offer won't last forever.
Wolf, I have the Kamerton. I don't know who to give it to.
Who? Nobody, kid. Whoever gets it will want to use it. Let's throw the damn thing into an anomaly and let the Zone eat it. I'll help you.
You're right. Let's destroy it.
Good call. Nobody gets rich off it, but nobody else dies because of it either. Here, this is a Soul - I was keeping it for a rainy day. You need it more than I do.
Think it over. But don't wait for someone to come and take it from you.
Cold (Clear Sky)
Sidorovich
Wolf

Stalker, Cold here. We heard about the convoy in Agroprom. If you have the Kamerton, bring it to the Swamps. Clear Sky will study it and find out what the Noise really is. Don't give it to anyone else.
Cold here. We heard about the convoy in Agroprom. If you have the Kamerton, bring it home to the Swamps. Clear Sky will study it and find out what the Noise really is.

Hey, rookie, Sidorovich here. I know what you carried out of Agroprom. Bring that box to my bunker in Cordon and I'll pay you enough to stay out of the Zone for a month. Don't listen to those idealists from the Swamps.
Wolf here. I heard what you've got. That thing has killed too many already. Come see me in the Cordon village and we'll destroy it together. Nobody should have it.
The Noise - storyline complete
The Kamerton went to Clear Sky. Cold and his techs will study the Noise, and you have allies in the Swamps. The main storyline "The Noise" is complete - the rest of the Zone is yours.
The Kamerton went to Clear Sky. Cold and the techs will study the Noise, and the whole base knows who brought it home. The main storyline "The Noise" is complete - the rest of the Zone is yours.
The Kamerton went to Sidorovich, and your pockets are full of rubles. Clear Sky won't forget this betrayal. The main storyline "The Noise" is complete - the rest of the Zone is yours.
You and Wolf destroyed the Kamerton. Nobody profits from it, and nobody else dies because of it. The main storyline "The Noise" is complete - the rest of the Zone is yours.
As soon as you touch the artifact, the earpiece fills with the Noise - then it fades into a steady, quiet tone, like a tuning fork that won't stop ringing.
Army Frequency Log
A ruggedized army data logger. Days of recorded frequencies - and one of them pulses exactly like the Noise.
Buyer's PDA
The PDA of the man who bought the Kamerton from Sidorovich. Encrypted messages to someone called "the Colonel".
Echo
An artifact formed where the Kamerton vanished into the anomaly. It is warm and rings quietly, like a tuning fork.
Mercenary Orders
Orders found on the leader of the mercenary scouts. They mention an "amplifier" and a transmitter under Agroprom.
Scientists' Journal
The journal of the scientists who went into the tunnels under Agroprom. The last entries describe a transmitter and armed guards.
Resonator R-7B
The heart of the transmitter under Agroprom: a twin of the Kamerton's core. Without it, the Noise falls silent.
The Noise: Reprisal
Stalker, Cold here. Something has happened - not something for the radio. Come to the base in the Swamps as soon as you can.
You called, Cold. What happened?

The Noise is back - you must have heard it too. And the army came with it: last night a patrol looking for the Kamerton shot up one of our outposts. Two of ours are dead. They're still in the Swamps, and they won't stop at one outpost. Deal with them. Then we'll talk about where the Noise is coming from - I have a theory.
I'll deal with the patrol.
They're marked on your PDA. Good hunting.
The Noise is back, and so is the army: a patrol looking for the Kamerton attacked a Clear Sky outpost. Cold wants them dealt with. They're marked on my PDA.
The patrol is dead. Report to Cold.
The patrol is dead.

Good. Listen - our techs took the Kamerton apart. It isn't a source, it's a receiver: an amplifier tuned to a transmitter somewhere else. And the army knows where. Their signal teams log every frequency they track, and I need one of those logs.
The Noise: Frequency Logs
Where do we get an army log?

There's an army signal team in Agroprom. They've been following the Noise for days and logging every frequency they pick up. If anyone knows where the signal comes from, it's in their log. They won't hand it over, so take it.
I'll get the log.
They're marked on your PDA. Agroprom is crawling with soldiers - pick your moment.
An army signal team in Agroprom is logging the Noise. Cold needs their frequency log. The team is marked on my PDA.
I have the army's frequency log. Take it to Cold.
Here's the army's frequency log.
Our techs will need an hour, but I can already see it. The strongest signal comes from under Agroprom - the old tunnels. Whoever hired those mercenaries built their transmitter down there.
The Noise: The Buyer
Rookie, Sidorovich here. Drop by the bunker - we have a problem, and not one for the radio.
You said we have a problem?

Two problems, rookie. One: the man who bought the Kamerton never paid the second half. Two: that noise is back on my radio, so whatever he bought, he's using it. His men are hanging around the Garbage. Bring me his PDA - I want to know who I really sold it to, before that someone decides I know too much.
I'll get his PDA.
They're marked on your PDA. And be careful - people who don't pay their debts usually don't mind shooting either.
Sid's buyer never paid for the Kamerton, and the Noise is back. The buyer's men are in the Garbage. Sid wants the buyer's PDA. Their position is marked on my PDA.
I have the buyer's PDA. Return to Sidorovich.
The buyer won't be paying anyone now. Here's his PDA.

Let's see... Ha. "Buyer." He was never from the Big Land, rookie - he worked for some colonel. The Kamerton went straight back to the people who built it. Damn. And there's worse: Clear Sky found out who sold it.
The Noise: Clear Sky's Debt
Clear Sky? What do they want?
To settle accounts - with you, with me, they don't care which. They sent a squad, and it's in Cordon now. Deal with them before they deal with us. Then we'll talk about what that PDA says.
I'll deal with them.
They're marked on your PDA. Don't let them get anywhere near the bunker.
Clear Sky hasn't forgotten who sold the Kamerton. A Clear Sky squad is in Cordon looking for me. I need to deal with them. They're marked on my PDA.
The Clear Sky squad is dead. Return to Sidorovich.
Clear Sky's squad won't bother us anymore.

Good. Now, about that PDA: the colonel's people took the Kamerton into the old tunnels under Agroprom. That's where the noise comes from. I sold the thing, so I suppose it's my mess. Yours too, rookie.
The Noise: Echo
Kid, it's Wolf. Come to the village. Something is going on at the anomaly field - you'll want to hear this.
What's going on at the anomaly field?

Remember where we threw the Kamerton in? Since last night something has been humming there. I went to look: there's an artifact where the anomaly swallowed it. The same noise, only quieter. If the Zone kept an echo of that thing, I want it in our hands, not in the hands of whoever comes looking for it. Go and get it.
I'll get it.
The spot is marked on your PDA. Throw bolts - the field is restless.
Something has formed in the anomaly field where Wolf and I threw the Kamerton in, and the Noise is back. Wolf wants me to get it. Better throw bolts ahead of me.
I have the strange artifact. It hums. Take it to Wolf.
I've got it. It hums, Wolf - the same Noise, only quieter.

So the Zone kept an echo of it. Hold on to that thing for now, kid. And watch out: if the Kamerton left an echo here, someone will come looking for it. Strangers have already been asking about it in the village.
The Noise: Strangers in Cordon
What strangers?

Mercenaries. Two or three of them, snooping around Cordon and asking about the Kamerton - where it went, who saw it last. Somebody sent them, and I want to know who. Deal with them and search their leader.
I'll find out who sent them.
They're marked on your PDA. Careful, they're no rookies.
Mercenary scouts are snooping around Cordon, asking about the Kamerton. Wolf wants to know who sent them. I need to deal with them and search their leader. They're marked on my PDA.
I have the mercenaries' orders. Take them to Wolf.
Their leader had orders on him.

Let me read... "Recover the amplifier or a replacement. The transmitter under Agroprom is useless without it." So that's it: there's a transmitter in the tunnels under Agroprom, and without the Kamerton it can't work properly - that's why the Noise is so faint. They'll keep trying, unless someone shuts it down.
The Noise: Under Agroprom
So it all leads to the tunnels under Agroprom?

Everything points there. And there's more: a group of scientists went down two days ago to measure the signal, and nobody has heard from them since. Go down there, find them, and find out what's in those tunnels.
I'm going under Agroprom.
Their last position is marked on your PDA. Take plenty of ammo - and a good flashlight.
The trail of the Noise leads to the tunnels under Agroprom. A group of scientists went down there and never came back. I need to find them. Their last position is marked on my PDA.
The scientists are dead. Their journal mentions a transmitter deeper in the tunnels and the mercenaries guarding it - and the mercenaries are coming. I need to deal with them.
The mercenaries are dead.
The scientists' journal, last entry: "The signal comes from the old pump room. They have a transmitter there, and armed guards. They saw us..." Footsteps in the tunnel. Mercenaries.
The Noise: The Transmitter
The journal says the transmitter is deeper in the tunnels, in the old pump room. Find its guards, take the resonator out of it and bring it to me. Without it, the Noise stops.
The transmitter is hidden deeper in the tunnels under Agroprom, guarded by mercenaries. I need to kill the guards and pull the resonator out of the transmitter. It's marked on my PDA.
I have the resonator.
Pull out the resonator
Pull out the resonator ($$ACTION_USE$$)
The guards are still around. I need to deal with them first.
The Noise: Silence
The Noise went quiet a minute ago. Was that you? Bring the resonator to the Swamps.
The transmitter under Agroprom is silent. Cold wants the resonator brought to the Clear Sky base.
Take the resonator to Cold.
Cold, the transmitter is silent. Here's its resonator.
...Without this, nobody will be playing with emissions again. Not the army, not the colonel. Kostya, Viktor, all of them - this is what they died for.
Is it over?
The Noise is over. The Zone never is. But today Clear Sky owes you, stalker, and we pay our debts.
The Noise is over. The Zone never is. But today the whole base owes you, and Clear Sky pays its debts.
The Noise: Silence
Rookie, my radio has gone quiet - I take it that was you. Bring that thing here, we'll talk.
The transmitter under Agroprom is silent. Sidorovich wants the resonator brought to his bunker.
Take the resonator to Sidorovich.
Sid, the transmitter is silent. Here's the resonator.
Well, well. And to think I sold the first one... Don't look at me like that, rookie. This one I'm not selling. It's going so deep into my bunker even I won't find it.
And my pay?
Your pay is that the colonel's toy won't work anymore. ...Fine, fine. Here. And don't let anyone say Sidorovich doesn't pay his debts.
The Noise: Silence
Kid, the echo has stopped ringing. You did it. Come back to the village - and bring whatever you took out of there.
The transmitter under Agroprom is silent. Wolf wants me back in the village with the resonator.
Take the resonator to Wolf.
Wolf, the transmitter is silent. Here's its resonator.
Give it here... We'll do with it what we did with the Kamerton. The Zone will eat it, and this time there won't be an echo.
And the artifact? It has stopped humming.
Then it goes in with the resonator. Take this instead - you've earned it, kid. The Noise is over.
The Noise: Aftermath - complete
The resonator went to Clear Sky and the transmitter under Agroprom is silent. The Noise is over - this time for good.
Sidorovich buried the resonator deep in his bunker, and the transmitter under Agroprom is silent. The Noise is over - this time for good.
You and Wolf gave the resonator to the Zone, and this time it left no echo. The Noise is over - this time for good.
